subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓ Did you try dragging the [set sprite to] block to a different place in the code?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓Which code block should be first? Why? What happens if you change the order of the code blocks?


Solution: The sprite needs to be set before its position can be set. Any block that refers to the sprite needs to come after its [set sprite to] block.
